functional_groups.search_keywords: starter solenoid pinion pre-engaged overrunning clutch
functional_groups.behavior: Engage axial; drive flywheel saat cranking; tarik pinion saat engine catches. Housing/stator tetap.

functional_groups.search_keywords: four stroke diesel crankshaft connecting rod cam valve rocker working
functional_groups.behavior: Crank memutar cam; piston translasi dan rod berayun; valve via cam/pushrod/rocker; spring kompresi mengikuti valve.
functional_groups.limits: Timing ideal/clearance masih ikuti register lama sampai sumber exact dibuktikan.

functional_groups.search_keywords: inline injection pump cam plunger barrel delivery valve working
functional_groups.behavior: Cam mendorong tappet/plunger; spring return; delivery valve conditional. Urutan1-4-2-6-3-5; interval60deg pada pump.
functional_groups.limits: D01 PDF115: WET YPE1615; PDF149 FID 16 ±0.5° BTDC adalah timing pompa, bukan otomatis awal spray atau nyala. Jangan gunakan rotary VE/common rail.

functional_groups.search_keywords: mechanical inline injection pump governor weights rack starting stopping
functional_groups.behavior: Start weights closed dan rack maksimum; idle weights membuka; Stop rack ke posisi fuel cutoff terlepas gaya governor.
functional_groups.limits: D01PDF116 fungsi terdokumentasi; transienttime/lift model tetap illustrative.

functional_groups.search_keywords: mechanical diesel injector nozzle needle spring working
functional_groups.behavior: Body tetap; nozzle WET TP2: needle lift 0.5 ±0.01 mm, opening 31 ±0.5 MPa; spring menutup. Delapan hole 0.30 mm dan empat hole 0.22 mm, sudut spray 160°/90° (D01 PDF150–151).
functional_groups.limits: Video belum terverifikasi; manual PDF150–151 diperiksa langsung. Jangan menyisipkan piezo. Azimuth dan hydraulic delay belum diketahui.

functional_groups.search_keywords: diesel fuel feed pump double action piston four check valves cam
functional_groups.behavior: Piston double acting digerakkan cam; empat checkvalve berganti menurut chamber pressure; manual priming tidak berputar saat engine run.
functional_groups.limits: D01PDF145 menyatakan four checkvalves; pressurelimit dapat membatasi piston. Modelgerakperiodik bukan physicalpressure solver.

functional_groups.search_keywords: external gear lubricating oil pump relief valve working
functional_groups.behavior: Gear pumping membawa oli melalui cooler/filter→gallery→bearing/rocker/piston/turbo/injectionpump→sump. Relief conditional, bukan openclose tiapputaran.
functional_groups.limits: KONFLIK r05 ratio32/28 vs manual1689rpm@1900. Piping diberi tindakan koreksi; sumber tabel PDF157.

functional_groups.search_keywords: centrifugal jacket cooling water pump impeller working
functional_groups.limits: Rasio/arah dari registerYanmar; aliran bukan CFD.

functional_groups.search_keywords: flexible impeller seawater pump vane eccentric cam working
functional_groups.behavior: Rotor bergerak dan vane lentur terhadap cam tetap; seawaterpump→aircooler→heat exchanger→sea.
functional_groups.limits: D01PDF163 shaft1572@crank1900. Deformation approximate tidak boleh disebut material simulation.

functional_groups.search_keywords: alternator rotor stator belt pulley working
functional_groups.behavior: Pulley/belt/rotor bergerak; stator, rectifier dan casing tetap. Rotor berputar di stator; keluaran lewat penyearah.
functional_groups.limits: Rasio puliYanmar dari existingreconstruction, jangan genericcar ratio.

functional_groups.search_keywords: turbocharger turbine compressor shaft intercooler working
functional_groups.behavior: Exhaust memutar turbine+compressor commonshaft; udara menujuaircooler laluengine; casingdiam.
functional_groups.limits: RPM dan spoollag ilustratif; 280000rpmGarrett dilarang dipindah.

functional_groups.search_keywords: oil filter shell tube heat exchanger fluid function
functional_groups.behavior: Filtermedia/tubes/baffles tetap; tampilkanaliran dua mediumterpisah dan perpindahanpanas secaraindikatif. Centrifugal bypassfilter rotor berbeda dari mainpaperfilter.
functional_groups.limits: Jangan menggerakkan seluruh filter/cooler agar terlihat bekerja. Tekanan/suhu angka belum solver.

critical_findings.action: Inspect actual geartrain and correct motion ratio; cannot infer toothcount solely from rounded RPM.
Need start/idle/stop rack and weights conditional behavior, not merely shaft spin.
